body.name: Common-cutoff inverse-tail handle
body.construction: Start from \(\Phi(-v)/\phi(v)=v^{-1}\int_0^{\infty}e^{-s}e^{-s^2/(2v^2)}\,ds\), retain the signed-rectangle representation for \(B_{\rho,\ell}\), and seek one common cutoff and remainder ledger valid for all \((c_{\ell1},c_{\ell2},c_{\ell3})\in[1/2,4]^3\).
